rules: No audit lead is promoted automatically.
Ordinary logic and source-status, motivational, prescriptive, evaluative, or bare source-association modality do not become G1 primitive-demand occurrences.

When an audit lead mixes a mathematical occurrence with a source analogy/association, conserve only the explicitly stated mathematical occurrence and leave the analogy/association at Core source-relation level.
No textbook semantics, conventional mathematical category assignment, primitive proposal, or W/L correspondence is introduced.
